_comment: Plugin wiring. Paths resolve through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, because a plugin lives
Three carriers for one identity, and the reason is measured rather than aesthetic.
A running auto-compaction fires SessionStart NOT AT ALL, and after a manual /compact
the reinject can lose the race against the next message. UserPromptSubmit cannot lose
a race, so it carries the one line. The guard is the last carrier: its refusal names
the role, and nobody can forget to call it.
The subagent launch carries BOTH names of one tool, and that is measured rather than
belt and braces. The runtime hands the hook tool_name 'Agent': 4335 of 4335 real
launches on the machine this was built on, 2026-11-02, and not one 'Task'. 'Task' is
the name the tool used to have, and a matcher that spells it still selects the tool,
because the matcher list is canonicalised through a legacy alias table before it is
compared. Naming only the old spelling would make this wiring depend on a
compatibility shim nobody promised to keep; naming only the new one would miss a host
that still sends the old payload. Both cost nothing.
